overall: The AG declined to review the untimely complaint about the Board's response to an executive session minutes request, and found no violation in the periodic review of withheld minutes. No orders issued; reminders only.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to properly respond within ten days to her January 2015 request for executive session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed with the Board on April 6, 2015 - almost a month later- we find this allegation untimely and decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to periodically review its executive session minutes at reasonable intervals, so the minutes stayed withheld.
allegations.key_passage: We find this to be a reasonable period of time between periodic reviews and therefore find no violation of the Law.
